name: imessage
description: Reads Messages (iMessage and SMS) on a Mac for who is waiting on a reply, catching up on a thread, finding what was said and what you promised. Read-only. Reads message text by default so it can tell a question from a thank-you; profile `redacted` hides the text.

waiting-on-me.prompt: Use the waiting-on-me skill to find what is waiting on me in Messages.

waiting-on-them.prompt: Use the waiting-on-them skill to find what I am waiting on others for in Messages.

action-now.prompt: Use the waiting-on-me and action-now-or-soon skills to answer action-now: what I need to act on today in Messages.

action-soon.prompt: Use the waiting-on-me and action-now-or-soon skills to answer action-soon: what I need to act on soon in Messages.

my-commitments.prompt: Use the my-commitments skill to find the promises I made in Messages: what I said I would do, to whom, the date and whether I appear to have done it. Take the period from the caller; default to the last 14 days.

catch-up.prompt: Use the catch-up skill to catch me up on one conversation, thread or topic in Messages: where it stands, what happened and what is open. Take the subject from the caller; if none is given, ask for one.

find.prompt: Use the find skill to find what the caller asks for in Messages (something someone said, a number, an address, a plan) and name where and when. Take the search from the caller; if none is given, ask for one.
